baseline.input: CORD annotated text and boxes; excludes OCR errors

learned.input: CORD annotated text and boxes; excludes OCR errors

actual_ocr_pipeline.sampling: Seed 42 without replacement from official test split; count fixed before evaluation
actual_ocr_pipeline.input: Actual CORD receipt pixels -> RapidOCR ONNX -> frozen line classifier -> deterministic extraction
actual_ocr_pipeline.annotation_matching_note: Matches reference lines to highest-IoU OCR box; split/merged lines conservatively penalized. Unannotated text has no reference. This is not character error rate.

limitations: These are Indonesian receipt results, not invoice or Arabic accuracy.
Line label F1 and document financial extraction accuracy measure different tasks.
Actual OCR benchmark is a seeded subset, separate from all 100 annotated-text receipts.
Validation review threshold is not a correctness guarantee or permission to autoapprove expenses.

transformer.evaluation_mode: CORD supplied text and bounding boxes plus receipt image
limitations: Line-level classification, not full-document exact-match accuracy
Indonesian receipt benchmark, not arbitrary English or Arabic invoices

assisted.input: Actual pixels -> RapidOCR -> frozen learned classifier -> explicit text anchors
assisted.development_note: Assisted design followed raw benchmark failure analysis; geometric rules were fixed before separate validation and additional test evaluation. No test values were used to tune parameters.
limitations: Text recovery is deterministic assistance, not trained model accuracy.
Anchor confidence is zero and every document requires human review.
This additional operational evaluation does not replace the original model benchmark.
